details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url at 3040-3052, _resolve_origin_url at 3081-3083 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using command-scoped http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, Git diagnostics, traces, and persisted remote configuration, reintroducing the credential-leak surface the previous authentication contract prevented.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url at 581-585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN directly in the URL.
  WHY: The token is exposed through clone, push, ls-remote arguments and Git diagnostics.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch at 151, 180; removal of _memory_git | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_git was removed and memory operations now use unauthenticated Git commands against an origin configured with persist-credentials: false.
  WHY: Branch probes and pushes fail with `could not read Username`, causing memory initialization and updates to be silently skipped.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path at 240-247, deleted is_sensitive_target_path at 152-154 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and the symlink-resolved second check were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, or `.aws/credentials` can be resolved and included in model prompts, exposing secrets.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:668 (codex invocation line) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose invocation bypasses the model-provider broker and runs `codex exec --sandbox danger-full-access` with workflow credentials in scope.
  WHY: Issue- and log-derived prompts can read credentials, mutate the workspace, or execute arbitrary commands instead of remaining brokered and read-only.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:File ends at line 140; functions model_provider_broker_start, model_provider_broker_stop, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_writer, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_readonly, model_provider_broker_exec_sanitized, model_provider_broker_exec_unprivileged, model_provider_broker_grant_read_path all deleted | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle and execution APIs were deleted while live callers still invoke them.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found` before Codex starts, removing the credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:99-112 (option parser), 143-148 (validation removed), 258 (hardcoded base_url) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` and its validation were removed while callers still pass the option, and the provider URL is hard-coded to the public OpenRouter endpoint.
  WHY: Existing callers fail with `unknown argument: --provider-base-url`, and brokered calls cannot use the loopback provider URL.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:496 (git_with_github_auth removed), 947 (review_blocked_* family removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the review-blocked helper family were deleted while review-blocked consumers still invoke them.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes and terminal approval, successor-issue, and review-blocked state-machine flows fail with command-not-found or remain pending.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest at 768-769, gh_pr_with_all_comments GraphQL at 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comment payloads drop `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`, and sorting no longer uses comment IDs.
  WHY: Approval verification cannot bind producer comments or authorize trusted approvers even if the deleted helpers are restored.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:7 (usage), 30-64 (option parser missing --process-group-file), shell helpers _process_identity, _write_process_group_metadata, _isolated_group_has_members, _process_group_exists, _verify_isolated_group_stopped, _reap_child_after_kill, _child_identity_matches, _isolated_group_alive, _signal_child_group all removed or rewritten to strip isolated-editor semantics | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and isolated-editor process-group supervision were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with `unknown option: --process-group-file`, and surviving isolated descendants are no longer tracked, killed, or verified.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context at 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The path-count and byte-budget caps were removed, and headers and markers do not advance `used_bytes`.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can exceed the targeted context and Codex stdin limits; strict-bounds tests also fail.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:30, 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The tests still import deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError` before any tests run.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:Memory-helper fetch step, removal of GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 exports | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Step-local Git authentication configuration is removed or expires before later memory operations.
  WHY: Later lineage finalization runs without credentials against unauthenticated HTTPS origins and silently drops memory writes.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:staged-support restore block (lines 98-237) and `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR` consumers (lines 440-448, 577-585) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Staged-support restoration depends on variables and directories that no workflow creates or exports.
  WHY: The restore protection is dead code, allowing support-file overlays to overwrite branch-owned helper changes.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:59-62 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The `pre_assembled_static.txt` cleanup changed from a HEAD-based check with index cleanup to an index/worktree-only path.
  WHY: Detached or staged-deletion cases can leave stale artifacts or staged deletions and cause the commit script to miss the intended cleanup.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-68 (pre_assembled_static.txt cleanup) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The changed cleanup can preserve an index entry absent from HEAD and then fail when restoring from HEAD.
  WHY: A staged-but-untracked generated artifact can make the commit script abort under `set -euo pipefail`.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:deleted `_isolated_group_has_members`, `_verify_isolated_group_stopped`, `_signal_child_group`, `_write_process_group_metadata`, and the `ISOLATED_USER` path | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user survivor detection, metadata recording, and privileged process-group termination were removed.
  WHY: An editor descendant that ignores forwarded termination can survive the wrapper and run indefinitely.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:lines 211-216 and line 668 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config` can fail with only a warning while diagnosis proceeds using stale configuration.
  WHY: Read-only or malformed configuration failures do not stop the diagnose path.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:lines 10-19 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The source path changed from repo-relative `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` to `${LABEL_HELPERS_SCRIPT_DIR}/gh_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Consumers sourcing the helper from arbitrary locations may experience a compatibility regression.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:git merge-file invocation (lines 204-206) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` arguments use the wrong base/other ordering for the staged-support rebase.
  WHY: Three-way merges can drop branch changes or produce incorrect conflict markers.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py:Multiple deleted identifiers across all six files | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing helper APIs, CLI flags, module exports, and payload fields were removed or repurposed without aliases or caller migration.
  WHY: Live callers and tests fail with command-not-found, unknown-argument, ImportError, or broken authorization behavior, violating naming immutability.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Config generation can no longer target the loopback broker.
  WHY: Consumers either fail on the removed option or proceed against the public API with the real provider key.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
